propositions: Per-client bearer PATs must be materialized on-box from SSM (not rsync'd) into gitignored .env as MCP_CLIENT_PAT_* env vars at deploy time
The static verifier's tokens JSON file (mcp-static-tokens.json) must reference credentials via token_env (env var names) rather than plaintext token values or raw PAT literals

Credential rotation requires operator-driven process restart/container replacement to trigger StaticBearerVerifier re-initialization and token re-read; file-only updates have no effect on running verifiers

A committed repo-root template (mcp-clients.local.example.json) with placeholders must exist alongside a gitignored real config (mcp-clients.local.json) so operators have documented shape without committing secrets
Both mcp-static-tokens.json and mcp-clients.local.json must be added to .gitignore and excluded from rsync in autodeploy.sh to prevent value-only re-materialization from being clobbered

When all per-client PAT slots are empty, the tokens file is created as empty list and verifier fails-closed at startup with a guard assertion that no real PAT patterns appear anywhere in the committed tree
